{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where true outcomes continue declining longer than predicted",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive correlates with near-term price continuation in the same direction",
    "Model mean-reversion to historical averages is too aggressive, especially when base price deviates more than 3 from the 30-day average",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (0.67+), model under-forecasts prices by approximately 0.5-1.0 on early days",
    "Price momentum from sentiment leads to forecast overshoot on initial days of different price regimes",
    "Model lacks recognition of price level resistance at major historical boundaries like 65 and 70",
    "Sentiment exhaustion (returning to 0 after sustained activity) precedes true outcome consolidation at similar levels"
] }
